WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM stars
  WHERE "Spectral Class" = 'M'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS star_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS temp_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS lum_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS rad_median
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
covariance AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_color,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - s.lum_mean)) AS cov_temp_lum,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Radius (R/Ro)" - s.rad_mean)) AS cov_temp_rad
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN stats s ON f."Star color" = s.star_color
  GROUP BY s.star_color
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_color,
    s.cnt,
    s.temp_mean,
    s.temp_median,
    s.temp_std,
    s.temp_min,
    s.temp_max,
    s.lum_mean,
    s.lum_median,
    s.lum_std,
    s.lum_min,
    s.lum_max,
    s.rad_mean,
    s.rad_median,
    s.rad_std,
    s.rad_min,
    s.rad_max,
    CASE
      WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.lum_std = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE cov.cov_temp_lum / (s.temp_std * s.lum_std)
    END AS temp_lum_corr,
    CASE
      WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.rad_std = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE cov.cov_temp_rad / (s.temp_std * s.rad_std)
    END AS temp_rad_corr,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%red%' OR LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%orange%' THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS typical
  FROM stats s
  JOIN covariance cov ON s.star_color = cov.star_color
)
SELECT *
FROM final
ORDER BY star_color;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM stars
  WHERE "Spectral Class" = 'M'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS star_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS temp_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS lum_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS rad_median
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
covariance AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_color,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - s.lum_mean)) AS cov_temp_lum,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Radius (R/Ro)" - s.rad_mean)) AS cov_temp_rad
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN stats s ON f."Star color" = s.star_color
  GROUP BY s.star_color
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_color,
    s.cnt,
    s.temp_mean,
    s.temp_median,
    s.temp_std,
    s.temp_min,
    s.temp_max,
    s.lum_mean,
    s.lum_median,
    s.lum_std,
    s.lum_min,

    s.rad_mean,

    CASE
      WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.lum_std = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE cov.cov_temp_lum / (s.temp_std * s.lum_std)
    END AS temp_lum_corr,
    CASE
      WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.rad_std = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE cov.cov_temp_rad / (s.temp_std * s.rad_std)
    END AS temp_rad_corr,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%red%' OR LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%orange%' THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS typical
  FROM stats s

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(replace(trim("Star color"), '-', ' ')) AS cleaned_color
  FROM stars
),
class_counts AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
         "Star category" AS Category,
         COUNT(*) AS cat_count,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class") AS total_count
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"
),
class_ranked AS (
  SELECT SpectralClass, Category, cat_count, total_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SpectralClass ORDER BY cat_count DESC, Category) AS rn
  FROM class_counts
)
SELECT SpectralClass, Category AS MajorityCategory, cat_count AS Count,
       ROUND(cat_count::DOUBLE / total_count, 4) AS Accuracy
FROM class_ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY SpectralClass;

message:
{
  "summary": "The analysis is encapsulated in a single view that, when supplied with a flagged‑results table, will return every flagged star’s detailed attributes, followed by aggregated temperature, luminosity, and radius statistics for both flagged and non‑flagged groups, a count of color‑mismatch cases, and a final summary of flagged versus non‑flagged counts.  All calculations exclude rows with NULLs in any of the relevant columns.  Because the original dataset does not contain a Flag column, the view assumes a separate table `flagged_results` (with columns RowID, Spectral_Class, Class_Code, Mv, Predicted_Mv, Residual, Abs_Residual, Flag) is provided; if this table is missing, the view will return an empty result set.",
  "view_requested": {
    "name": "star_flagged_analysis",
    "sql": "WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT * FROM flagged_results
),
joined AS (
  SELECT f.RowID,
         f.Spectral_Class,
         f.Class_Code,
         f.Mv,
         f.Predicted_Mv,
         f.Residual,
         f.Abs_Residual,
         s."Star Category" AS Star_Category,
         s."Star Color" AS Star_Color,
         s.Temperature,
         s.Luminosity,
         s.Radius
  FROM flagged f
  JOIN stars s ON s."Spectral Class" = f.Spectral_Class
  WHERE f.Flag = 1
    AND s.Temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND s.Luminosity IS NOT NULL
    AND s.Radius IS NOT NULL
    AND s."Star Category" IS NOT NULL
    AND s."Star Color" IS NOT NULL
),
stats_flagged AS (
  SELECT

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM stars WHERE "Spectral Class" = 'M'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS star_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
median_temp AS (
  SELECT "Star color", "Temperature (K)" AS temp_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color",
      "Temperature (K)",
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) t
  QUALIFY rn = (cnt + 1) / 2
),
median_lum AS (
  SELECT "Star color", "Luminosity (L/Lo)" AS lum_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color",
      "Luminosity (L/Lo)",
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) t
  QUALIFY rn = (cnt + 1) / 2
),
median_rad AS (
  SELECT "Star color", "Radius (R/Ro)" AS rad_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color",
      "Radius (R/Ro)",
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) t
  QUALIFY rn = (cnt + 1) / 2
),
covariance AS (
  SELECT
    f."Star color" AS star_color,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - s.lum_mean)) AS cov_temp_lum,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Radius (R/Ro)" - s.rad_mean)) AS cov_temp_rad
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN stats s ON f."Star color" = s.star_color
  GROUP BY f."Star color"
)
SELECT
  s.star_color,
  s.cnt,
  s.temp_mean,
  mt.temp_median,
  s.temp_std,
  s.temp_min,
  s.temp_max,
  s.lum_mean,
  ml.lum_median,
  s.lum_std,
  s.lum_min,
  s.lum_max,
  s.rad_mean,
  mr.rad_median,
  s.rad_std,
  s.rad_min,
  s.rad_max,
  CASE WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.lum_std = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cov.cov_temp_lum / (s.temp_std * s.lum_std) END AS temp_lum_corr,
  CASE WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.rad_std = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cov.cov_temp_rad / (s.temp_std * s.rad_std) END AS temp_rad_corr,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%red%' OR LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%orange%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS typical
FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN median_temp mt ON s.star_color = mt.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_lum ml ON s.star_color = ml.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_rad mr ON s.star_color = mr.star_color
LEFT JOIN covariance cov ON s.star_color = cov.star_color
ORDER BY s.star_color;

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM stars WHERE "Spectral Class" = 'M'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS star_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
median_temp AS (
  SELECT star_color, temp_value AS temp_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color" AS star_color,
      "Temperature (K)" AS temp_value,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = ((cnt + 1) / 2)::INTEGER
),
median_lum AS (
  SELECT star_color, lum_value AS lum_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color" AS star_color,
      "Luminosity (L/Lo)" AS lum_value,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = ((cnt + 1) / 2)::INTEGER
),
median_rad AS (
  SELECT star_color, rad_value AS rad_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color" AS star_color,
      "Radius (R/Ro)" AS rad_value,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = ((cnt + 1) / 2)::INTEGER
),
covariance AS (
  SELECT
    f."Star color" AS star_color,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - s.lum_mean)) AS cov_temp_lum,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Radius (R/Ro)" - s.rad_mean)) AS cov_temp_rad
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN stats s ON f."Star color" = s.star_color
  GROUP BY f."Star color"
)
SELECT
  s.star_color,
  s.cnt,
  s.temp_mean,
  mt.temp_median,
  s.temp_std,
  s.temp_min,
  s.temp_max,
  s.lum_mean,
  ml.lum_median,
  s.lum_std,
  s.lum_min,
  s.lum_max,
  s.rad_mean,
  mr.rad_median,
  s.rad_std,
  s.rad_min,
  s.rad_max,
  CASE WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.lum_std = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE cov.cov_temp_lum / (s.temp_std * s.lum_std)
  END AS temp_lum_corr,
  CASE WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.rad_std = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE cov.cov_temp_rad / (s.temp_std * s.rad_std)
  END AS temp_rad_corr,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%red%' OR LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%orange%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS typical
FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN median_temp mt ON s.star_color = mt.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_lum ml ON s.star_color = ml.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_rad mr ON s.star_color = mr.star_color
LEFT JOIN covariance cov ON s.star_color = cov.star_color
ORDER BY s.star_color;

LEFT JOIN median_temp mt ON s.star_color = mt.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_lum ml ON s.star_color = ml.star_color

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM stars WHERE "Spectral Class" = 'M'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS star_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
median_temp AS (
  SELECT star_color, temp_value AS temp_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color" AS star_color,
      "Temperature (K)" AS temp_value,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = ((cnt + 1) / 2)::INTEGER
),
median_lum AS (
  SELECT star_color, lum_value AS lum_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color" AS star_color,
      "Luminosity (L/Lo)" AS lum_value,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = ((cnt + 1) / 2)::INTEGER
),
median_rad AS (
  SELECT star_color, rad_value AS rad_median
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Star color" AS star_color,
      "Radius (R/Ro)" AS rad_value,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color" ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Star color") AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  ) sub
  WHERE rn = ((cnt + 1) / 2)::INTEGER
),
covariance AS (
  SELECT
    f."Star color" AS star_color,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - s.lum_mean)) AS cov_temp_lum,
    AVG((f."Temperature (K)" - s.temp_mean) * (f."Radius (R/Ro)" - s.rad_mean)) AS cov_temp_rad
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN stats s ON f."Star color" = s.star_color
  GROUP BY f."Star color"
)
SELECT
  s.star_color,
  s.cnt,
  s.temp_mean,
  mt.temp_median,
  s.temp_std,
  s.temp_min,
  s.temp_max,
  s.lum_mean,
  ml.lum_median,
  s.lum_std,
  s.lum_min,
  s.lum_max,
  s.rad_mean,
  mr.rad_median,
  s.rad_std,
  s.rad_min,
  s.rad_max,
  CASE WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.lum_std = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE cov.cov_temp_lum / (s.temp_std * s.lum_std)
  END AS temp_lum_corr,
  CASE WHEN s.temp_std = 0 OR s.rad_std = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE cov.cov_temp_rad / (s.temp_std * s.rad_std)
  END AS temp_rad_corr,
  CASE WHEN LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%red%' OR LOWER(s.star_color) LIKE '%orange%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS typical
FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN median_temp mt ON s.star_color = mt.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_lum ml ON s.star_color = ml.star_color
LEFT JOIN median_rad mr ON s.star_color = mr.star_color
LEFT JOIN covariance cov ON s.star_color = cov.star_color
ORDER BY s.star_color;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '-', ' '), '\\s+', ' ')) AS cleaned_color
  FROM stars
),
color_counts AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, "Star category" AS Category, COUNT(*) AS cat_count,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cleaned_color) AS total_count
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY cleaned_color, "Star category"
),
color_ranked AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, Category, cat_count, total_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cleaned_color ORDER BY cat_count DESC, Category) AS rn
  FROM color_counts
)
SELECT cleaned_color AS StarColor, Category AS MajorityCategory, cat_count AS Count,
       ROUND(cat_count::DOUBLE / total_count, 4) AS Accuracy
FROM color_ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY cleaned_color;

WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    "Temperature (K)",
    "Luminosity (L/Lo)",
    "Radius (R/Ro)"
  FROM stars
),
medians AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS temp_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS lum_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS rad_median
  FROM raw
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"
)
SELECT
  a."Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
  a."Star category" AS star_category,
  a.cnt,
  a.temp_mean,
  m.temp_median,
  a.temp_std,
  a.temp_min,
  a.temp_max,
  a.lum_mean,
  m.lum_median,
  a.lum_std,
  a.lum_min,
  a.lum_max,
  a.rad_mean,
  m.rad_median,
  a.rad_std,
  a.rad_min,
  a.rad_max
FROM agg a
JOIN medians m USING ("Spectral Class", "Star category")
ORDER BY a."Spectral Class", a."Star category";

WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    "Temperature (K)",
    "Luminosity (L/Lo)",
    "Radius (R/Ro)"
  FROM stars
),
medians AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS temp_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS lum_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS rad_median
  FROM raw
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"
)
SELECT
  a."Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
  a."Star category" AS star_category,
  a.cnt,
  a.temp_mean,
  m.temp_median,
  a.temp_std,
  a.temp_min,
  a.temp_max,
  a.lum_mean,
  m.lum_median,
  a.lum_std,
  a.lum_min,
  a.lum_max,
  a.rad_mean,
  m.rad_median,
  a.rad_std,
  a.rad_min,
  a.rad_max
FROM agg a
JOIN medians m USING ("Spectral Class", "Star category")
ORDER BY a."Spectral Class", a."Star category";

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '-', ' '), '\\s+', ' ')) AS cleaned_color
  FROM stars
),
class_counts AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
         "Star category" AS Category,
         COUNT(*) AS cat_count,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class") AS total_count
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"
),
class_ranked AS (
  SELECT SpectralClass, Category, cat_count, total_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SpectralClass ORDER BY cat_count DESC, Category) AS rn
  FROM class_counts
)
SELECT SpectralClass, Category AS MajorityCategory, cat_count AS Count,
       total_count, ROUND(cat_count::DOUBLE / total_count, 4) AS Accuracy
FROM class_ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY SpectralClass;

message:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class",
    "Star category",
    "Temperature (K)",
    "Luminosity (L/Lo)",
    "Radius (R/Ro)"
  FROM stars
),
 temp_median AS (
  SELECT spectral_class, star_category, AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_median
  FROM (
    SELECT "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
           "Star category",
           "Temperature (K)",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category" ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS cnt
    FROM stars
  ) t
  WHERE (cnt % 2 = 1 AND rn = (cnt + 1)/2) OR (cnt % 2 = 0 AND rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2 + 1))
  GROUP BY spectral_class, star_category
),
 lum_median AS (
  SELECT spectral_class, star_category, AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_median
  FROM (
    SELECT "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
           "Star category",
           "Luminosity (L/Lo)",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category" ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS cnt
    FROM stars
  ) t
  WHERE (cnt % 2 = 1 AND rn = (cnt + 1)/2) OR (cnt % 2 = 0 AND rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2 + 1))
  GROUP BY spectral_class, star_category
),
 rad_median AS (
  SELECT spectral_class, star_category, AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_median
  FROM (
    SELECT "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
           "Star category",
           "Radius (R/Ro)",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category" ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS cnt
    FROM stars
  ) t
  WHERE (cnt % 2 = 1 AND rn = (cnt + 1)/2) OR (cnt % 2 = 0 AND rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2 + 1))
  GROUP BY spectral_class, star_category
),
 agg AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
    "Star category" AS star_category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_std,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_std,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_max
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"
)
SELECT
  a.spectral_class,
  a.star_category,
  a.cnt,
  a.temp_mean,
  tm.temp_median,
  a.temp_std,
  a.temp_min,
  a.temp_max,
  a.lum_mean,
  lm.lum_median,
  a.lum_std,
  a.lum_min,
  a.lum_max,
  a.rad_mean,
  rm.rad_median,
  a.rad_std,
  a.rad_min,
  a.rad_max
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN temp_median tm USING (spectral_class, star_category)
LEFT JOIN lum_median lm USING (spectral_class, star_category)
LEFT JOIN rad_median rm USING (spectral_class, star_category)
ORDER BY a.spectral_class, a.star_category;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT TRIM(LOWER("Star color")) AS cleaned_color, "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class
  FROM stars
), color_counts AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, spectral_class, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY cleaned_color, spectral_class
), color_totals AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, SUM(cnt) AS n_total
  FROM color_counts
  GROUP BY cleaned_color
), dominant AS (
  SELECT cc.cleaned_color, cc.spectral_class AS dominant_spectral_class,
         cc.cnt AS n_dominant,
         ct.n_total
  FROM color_counts cc
  JOIN color_totals ct ON cc.cleaned_color = ct.cleaned_color
  WHERE cc.cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM color_counts WHERE cleaned_color = cc.cleaned_color)
)
SELECT cleaned_color,
       dominant_spectral_class,
       ROUND(n_dominant * 100.0 / n_total, 1) AS pct_of_color,
       n_dominant,
       n_total
FROM dominant
ORDER BY n_total DESC;

SELECT
  "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
  "Star category" AS StarCategory,
  COUNT(*) AS Count,
  AVG("Temperature (K)") AS TempMean,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") AS TempMedian,
  MIN("Temperature (K)") AS TempMin,
  MAX("Temperature (K)") AS TempMax,
  STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS TempStd,
  AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMean,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMedian,
  MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMin,
  MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMax,
  STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumStd,
  AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMean,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMedian,
  MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMin,
  MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMax,
  STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadStd
FROM stars
GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"
ORDER BY "Spectral Class", "Star category";

  STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumStd,
  AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMean,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMedian,

  MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMax,
  STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadStd
FROM stars
GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star category"

WITH total AS (SELECT count(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    count(*) AS n,
    round(count(*)*100.0/total.total,1) AS pct_of_all,
    avg("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
    avg("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
    avg("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars, total
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    count(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw_color,
      "Spectral Class",
      sc_count,
      rank() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rnk
    FROM spectral
  ) t
  WHERE rnk <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT
  raw.raw_color,
  raw.n,
  raw.pct_of_all,
  raw.avg_temp,
  raw.avg_lum,
  raw.avg_rad,
  top2.top2
FROM raw
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw.n DESC;

WITH temp_rank AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
         "Star category" AS star_category,
         "Temperature (K)" AS val,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category" ORDER BY "Temperature (K)") AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS cnt
  FROM stars
),
 temp_median AS (
  SELECT spectral_class, star_category,
         AVG(val) AS temp_median
  FROM temp_rank
  WHERE (cnt % 2 = 1 AND rn = (cnt + 1)/2) OR (cnt % 2 = 0 AND rn IN (cnt/2, cnt/2 + 1))
  GROUP BY spectral_class, star_category
),
 lum_rank AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class" AS spectral_class,
         "Star category" AS star_category,
         "Luminosity (L/Lo)" AS val,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category" ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Spectral Class", "Star category") AS cnt
  FROM stars
),
 lum_median AS (
  SELECT spectral_class, star_category,

message: The most striking pattern is the extreme luminosity and radius of the M‑class hypergiants: they average ~219 k L☉ and ~1 362 R☉, far above any other group.  In contrast, white dwarfs across all spectral classes exhibit very low temperatures and luminosities (e.g., M white dwarfs: mean ≈ 8 580 K, mean luminosity ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴ L☉).  B‑class main‑sequence stars have the highest mean temperatures (~21 700 K) and moderate luminosities (~23 k L☉). - SpectralClass
- StarCategory
- Count
- TempMean, TempMedian, TempMin, TempMax, TempStd
- LumMean, LumMedian, LumMin, LumMax, LumStd
- RadMean, RadMedian, RadMin, RadMax, RadStd

message:
SELECT
  "Star color" AS raw_color,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stars),1) AS pct_of_all,
  AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
  AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
  AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
FROM stars
GROUP BY "Star color"
ORDER BY n DESC;

message:
WITH spectral_counts AS (
  SELECT "Star color" AS raw_color, "Spectral Class", COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
), ranked AS (
  SELECT raw_color, "Spectral Class", sc_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral_counts
)
SELECT raw_color, string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
GROUP BY raw_color
ORDER BY raw_color;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *,
    initcap(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '[ -]+', '-')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
cat_stats AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    MIN(Temperature) AS min_temp,
    MAX(Temperature) AS max_temp,
    MIN(Luminosity) AS min_lum,
    MAX(Luminosity) AS max_lum,
    MIN(Radius) AS min_rad,
    MAX(Radius) AS max_rad,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
pair_inter AS (
  SELECT
    a.cat AS cat1,
    b.cat AS cat2,
    GREATEST(a.min_temp, b.min_temp) AS inter_min_temp,
    LEAST(a.max_temp, b.max_temp) AS inter_max_temp,
    GREATEST(a.min_lum, b.min_lum) AS inter_min_lum,
    LEAST(a.max_lum, b.max_lum) AS inter_max_lum,
    GREATEST(a.min_rad, b.min_rad) AS inter_min_rad,
    LEAST(a.max_rad, b.max_rad) AS inter_max_rad,
    a.total AS total1,
    b.total AS total2
  FROM cat_stats a
  JOIN cat_stats b
    ON a.cat < b.cat
),
valid_pairs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pair_inter
  WHERE inter_min_temp <= inter_max_temp
    AND inter_min_lum <= inter_max_lum
    AND inter_min_rad <= inter_max_rad
),
overlap_cat1 AS (
  SELECT
    vp.cat1,
    vp.cat2,
    c.clean_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM valid_pairs vp
  JOIN cleaned c
    ON c."Star category" = vp.cat1
   AND c.Temperature BETWEEN vp.inter_min_temp AND vp.inter_max_temp
   AND c.Luminosity BETWEEN vp.inter_min_lum AND vp.inter_max_lum
   AND c.Radius BETWEEN vp.inter_min_rad AND vp.inter_max_rad
  GROUP BY vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color
),
overlap_cat2 AS (
  SELECT
    vp.cat1,
    vp.cat2,
    c.clean_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM valid_pairs vp
  JOIN cleaned c
    ON c."Star category" = vp.cat2
   AND c.Temperature BETWEEN vp.inter_min_temp AND vp.inter_max_temp
   AND c.Luminosity BETWEEN vp.inter_min_lum AND vp.inter_max_lum
   AND c.Radius BETWEEN vp.inter_min_rad AND vp.inter_max_rad
  GROUP BY vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(oc1.cat1, oc2.cat1) AS cat1,
    COALESCE(oc1.cat2, oc2.cat2) AS cat2,
    COALESCE(oc1.clean_color, oc2.clean_color) AS color,
    COALESCE(oc1.cnt,0) AS cnt_cat1,
    COALESCE(oc2.cnt,0) AS cnt_cat2,
    (COALESCE(oc1.cnt,0) + COALESCE(oc2.cnt,0)) AS total_cnt,
    COALESCE(oc1.cnt,0) / vp.total1 AS prop_cat1,
    COALESCE(oc2.cnt,0) / vp.total2 AS prop_cat2
  FROM overlap_cat1 oc1
  FULL OUTER JOIN overlap_cat2 oc2
    ON oc1.cat1 = oc2.cat1
   AND oc1.cat2 = oc2.cat2
   AND oc1.clean_color = oc2.clean_color
  JOIN valid_pairs vp
    ON vp.cat1 = COALESCE(oc1.cat1, oc2.cat1)
   AND vp.cat2 = COALESCE(oc1.cat2, oc2.cat2)
)
SELECT cat1, cat2, color, total_cnt AS Count, prop_cat1 AS Proportion_of_Category1_Overlap, prop_cat2 AS Proportion_of_Category2_Overlap
FROM combined
ORDER BY cat1, cat2, color;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *,
    lower(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '[ -]+', '-')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
cat_stats AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS min_temp,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS max_temp,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS min_lum,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS max_lum,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS min_rad,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS max_rad,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
pair_inter AS (
  SELECT
    a.cat AS cat1,
    b.cat AS cat2,
    GREATEST(a.min_temp, b.min_temp) AS inter_min_temp,
    LEAST(a.max_temp, b.max_temp) AS inter_max_temp,
    GREATEST(a.min_lum, b.min_lum) AS inter_min_lum,
    LEAST(a.max_lum, b.max_lum) AS inter_max_lum,
    GREATEST(a.min_rad, b.min_rad) AS inter_min_rad,
    LEAST(a.max_rad, b.max_rad) AS inter_max_rad,
    a.total AS total1,
    b.total AS total2
  FROM cat_stats a
  JOIN cat_stats b
    ON a.cat < b.cat
),
valid_pairs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pair_inter
  WHERE inter_min_temp <= inter_max_temp
    AND inter_min_lum <= inter_max_lum
    AND inter_min_rad <= inter_max_rad
),
overlap_cat1 AS (
  SELECT
    vp.cat1,
    vp.cat2,
    c.clean_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM valid_pairs vp
  JOIN cleaned c
    ON c."Star category" = vp.cat1
   AND c."Temperature (K)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_temp AND vp.inter_max_temp
   AND c."Luminosity (L/Lo)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_lum AND vp.inter_max_lum
   AND c."Radius (R/Ro)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_rad AND vp.inter_max_rad
  GROUP BY vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color
),
overlap_cat2 AS (
  SELECT
    vp.cat1,
    vp.cat2,
    c.clean_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM valid_pairs vp
  JOIN cleaned c
    ON c."Star category" = vp.cat2
   AND c."Temperature (K)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_temp AND vp.inter_max_temp
   AND c."Luminosity (L/Lo)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_lum AND vp.inter_max_lum
   AND c."Radius (R/Ro)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_rad AND vp.inter_max_rad
  GROUP BY vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(oc1.cat1, oc2.cat1) AS cat1,
    COALESCE(oc1.cat2, oc2.cat2) AS cat2,
    COALESCE(oc1.clean_color, oc2.clean_color) AS color,
    COALESCE(oc1.cnt,0) AS cnt_cat1,
    COALESCE(oc2.cnt,0) AS cnt_cat2,
    COALESCE(oc1.cnt,0) + COALESCE(oc2.cnt,0) AS total_cnt,
    COALESCE(oc1.cnt,0) / vp.total1 AS prop_cat1,
    COALESCE(oc2.cnt,0) / vp.total2 AS prop_cat2
  FROM overlap_cat1 oc1
  FULL OUTER JOIN overlap_cat2 oc2
    ON oc1.cat1 = oc2.cat1
   AND oc1.cat2 = oc2.cat2
   AND oc1.clean_color = oc2.clean_color
  JOIN valid_pairs vp
    ON vp.cat1 = COALESCE(oc1.cat1, oc2.cat1)
   AND vp.cat2 = COALESCE(oc1.cat2, oc2.cat2)
)
SELECT cat1, cat2, color, total_cnt AS Count, prop_cat1 AS Proportion_of_Category1_Overlap, prop_cat2 AS Proportion_of_Category2_Overlap
FROM combined
ORDER BY cat1, cat2, color;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *,
    lower(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '[ -]+', '-')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
cat_stats AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS min_temp,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS max_temp,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS min_lum,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS max_lum,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS min_rad,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS max_rad,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
pair_inter AS (
  SELECT
    a.cat AS cat1,
    b.cat AS cat2,
    GREATEST(a.min_temp, b.min_temp) AS inter_min_temp,
    LEAST(a.max_temp, b.max_temp) AS inter_max_temp,
    GREATEST(a.min_lum, b.min_lum) AS inter_min_lum,
    LEAST(a.max_lum, b.max_lum) AS inter_max_lum,
    GREATEST(a.min_rad, b.min_rad) AS inter_min_rad,
    LEAST(a.max_rad, b.max_rad) AS inter_max_rad
  FROM cat_stats a
  JOIN cat_stats b
    ON a.cat < b.cat
),
valid_pairs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pair_inter
  WHERE inter_min_temp <= inter_max_temp
    AND inter_min_lum <= inter_max_lum
    AND inter_min_rad <= inter_max_rad
),
overlap AS (
  SELECT
    vp.cat1,
    vp.cat2,
    c.clean_color,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM valid_pairs vp
  JOIN cleaned c

   AND c."Luminosity (L/Lo)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_lum AND vp.inter_max_lum
   AND c."Radius (R/Ro)" BETWEEN vp.inter_min_rad AND vp.inter_max_rad
  GROUP BY vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color
)

instruction:
Run a single SQL query on the `stars` table filtered to `Spectral Class = 'M'`.  Group by `Star color`.  For each colour compute:
- `cnt` = COUNT(*)
- `temp_mean`, `temp_median`, `temp_std`, `temp_min`, `temp_max`
- `lum_mean`, `lum_median`, `lum_std`, `lum_min`, `lum_max`
- `rad_mean`, `rad_median`, `rad_std`, `rad_min`, `rad_max`
Use standard aggregates (AVG, COUNT, STDDEV_POP, MIN, MAX) and a window function or PERCENTILE_CONT to compute the median.  Return the results as a table with one row per colour.

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *,
    lower(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '[ -]+', '-')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
cat_stats AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
valid_pairs AS (
  SELECT a.cat AS cat1, b.cat AS cat2
  FROM cat_stats a
  JOIN cat_stats b ON a.cat < b.cat
),
intersect AS (
  SELECT vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM valid_pairs vp
  JOIN cleaned c ON c."Star category" = vp.cat1
  WHERE c."Temperature (K)" BETWEEN 2621 AND 3531
    AND c."Luminosity (L/Lo)" BETWEEN 0.00019 AND 0.0056
    AND c."Radius (R/Ro)" BETWEEN 0.098 AND 0.19
  GROUP BY vp.cat1, vp.cat2, c.clean_color
)
SELECT * FROM intersect;

WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/total.total,1) AS pct_of_all,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars, total
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    sc_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT
  raw.raw_color,
  raw.n,
  raw.pct_of_all,
  raw.avg_temp,
  raw.avg_lum,
  raw.avg_rad,
  top2.top2
FROM raw
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw.n DESC;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
    COUNT(*) AS Count,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS TempMean,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS TempMin,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS TempMax,
    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS TempStd,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMean,
    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMin,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMax,
    STDDEV_POP("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumStd,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMean,
    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMin,
    MAX("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMax,
    STDDEV_POP("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadStd
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class"
), color_counts AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
    json_object(array_agg("Star color"::VARCHAR), array_agg(color_count)) AS ColorCounts
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "Spectral Class",
      "Star color",
      COUNT(*) AS color_count
    FROM stars
    GROUP BY "Spectral Class", "Star color"
  ) sub
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class"
), objs AS (
  SELECT json_object(
    'SpectralClass', agg.SpectralClass,
    'Count', agg.Count,
    'Proportion', agg.Count / 240.0,
    'TempMean', agg.TempMean,
    'TempMin', agg.TempMin,
    'TempMax', agg.TempMax,
    'TempStd', agg.TempStd,
    'LumMean', agg.LumMean,
    'LumMin', agg.LumMin,
    'LumMax', agg.LumMax,
    'LumStd', agg.LumStd,
    'RadMean', agg.RadMean,
    'RadMin', agg.RadMin,
    'RadMax', agg.RadMax,
    'RadStd', agg.RadStd,
    'ColorCounts', color_counts.ColorCounts
  ) AS obj
  FROM agg
  JOIN color_counts USING (SpectralClass)
)
SELECT json_array(array_agg(obj)) AS result
FROM objs;

WITH cat_means AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS meanT,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS meanL,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS meanR
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
preds AS (
  SELECT s.*, (
    SELECT cat FROM cat_means cm
    ORDER BY pow(s."Temperature (K)"-cm.meanT,2)+pow(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-cm.meanL,2)+pow(s."Radius (R/Ro)"-cm.meanR,2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS PredCat_Physical
  FROM stars s
),
cat_acc AS (
  SELECT cat,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cat = PredCat_Physical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM preds
  GROUP BY cat
),
cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(replace(replace(trim("Star color"),' ','-'),'-','')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
color_cat_means AS (
  SELECT clean_color, "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS meanT,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS meanL,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS meanR
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY clean_color, "Star category"
),
color_preds AS (
  SELECT c.*, (
    SELECT cat FROM color_cat_means cm
    WHERE cm.clean_color = c.clean_color
    ORDER BY pow(c."Temperature (K)"-cm.meanT,2)+pow(c."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-cm.meanL,2)+pow(c."Radius (R/Ro)"-cm.meanR,2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS PredCat_PhysicalColor
  FROM cleaned c
),
cat_acc_color AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PredCat_PhysicalColor = "Star category" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM color_preds
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
color_acc AS (
  SELECT clean_color AS color,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PredCat_PhysicalColor = "Star category" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM color_preds
  GROUP BY clean_color
)
SELECT * FROM cat_acc;

WITH cat_means AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS meanT,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS meanL,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS meanR
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
preds AS (
  SELECT s.*, (
    SELECT cm.cat FROM cat_means cm
    ORDER BY pow(s."Temperature (K)"-cm.meanT,2)+pow(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-cm.meanL,2)+pow(s."Radius (R/Ro)"-cm.meanR,2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS PredCat_Physical
  FROM stars s
),
cat_acc AS (
  SELECT s."Star category" AS cat,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s."Star category" = PredCat_Physical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM preds s
  GROUP BY s."Star category"
),
cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(replace(replace(trim("Star color"),' ','-'),'-','')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
color_cat_means AS (
  SELECT clean_color, "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS meanT,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS meanL,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS meanR
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY clean_color, "Star category"
),
color_preds AS (
  SELECT c.*, (
    SELECT cm.cat FROM color_cat_means cm
    WHERE cm.clean_color = c.clean_color
    ORDER BY pow(c."Temperature (K)"-cm.meanT,2)+pow(c."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-cm.meanL,2)+pow(c."Radius (R/Ro)"-cm.meanR,2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS PredCat_PhysicalColor
  FROM cleaned c
),
cat_acc_color AS (
  SELECT c."Star category" AS cat,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c."Star category" = PredCat_PhysicalColor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM color_preds c
  GROUP BY c."Star category"
),
color_acc AS (
  SELECT clean_color AS color,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PredCat_PhysicalColor = "Star category" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM color_preds
  GROUP BY clean_color
)
SELECT cat, total, correct, correct/total AS accuracy
FROM cat_acc;

message:
WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/total.total,1) AS pct_of_all,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars, total
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    sc_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT
  raw.raw_color,
  raw.n,
  raw.pct_of_all,
  raw.avg_temp,
  raw.avg_lum,
  raw.avg_rad,
  top2.top2
FROM raw
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw.n DESC;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(replace(replace(trim("Star color"),' ','-'),'-','')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
color_cat_means AS (
  SELECT clean_color, "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS meanT,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS meanL,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS meanR
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY clean_color, "Star category"
),
color_preds AS (
  SELECT c.*, (
    SELECT cm.cat FROM color_cat_means cm
    WHERE cm.clean_color = c.clean_color
    ORDER BY pow(c."Temperature (K)"-cm.meanT,2)+pow(c."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-cm.meanL,2)+pow(c."Radius (R/Ro)"-cm.meanR,2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS PredCat_PhysicalColor
  FROM cleaned c
),
color_acc AS (
  SELECT clean_color AS color,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PredCat_PhysicalColor = "Star category" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct
  FROM color_preds
  GROUP BY clean_color
)
SELECT color, total, correct, correct/total AS accuracy
FROM color_acc
ORDER BY color;

message:
WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/total.total,1) AS pct_of_all,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars, total
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    sc_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT
  raw.raw_color,
  raw.n,
  raw.pct_of_all,
  raw.avg_temp,
  raw.avg_lum,
  raw.avg_rad,
  top2.top2
FROM raw
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw.n DESC;

instruction:
Using SQL, compute the following:
1. Overall summary of Luminosity and Radius: count, mean, median, stddev, min, max, 10th, 25th, 75th, 90th percentiles.
2. For each Star category, compute the same summary for Luminosity and Radius.
3. For each Star type (numeric), compute the same summary for Luminosity and Radius.
4. Compute the Pearson correlation coefficient between Luminosity and Radius for the full dataset.
5. Identify the top 10 stars by Luminosity and the top 10 by Radius, listing their Star category, Star type, Spectral Class, and color.
Return the results as a single JSON object with keys: "overall", "by_category", "by_type", "correlation", "top_luminosity", "top_radius".

    STDDEV_POP("Temperature (K)") AS temp_std,
    MIN("Temperature (K)") AS temp_min,
    MAX("Temperature (K)") AS temp_max,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_median,

    MIN("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_min,
    MAX("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_max,

    MIN("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_min,

    SUM("Temperature (K)" * "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS sum_temp_lum,

  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY "Star category"

WITH cleaned AS (
 SELECT *, initcap(regexp_replace(trim(replace(lower(`Star color`), '-', ' ')), '\\s+', ' ')) AS cleaned_color
 FROM stars
),
class_counts AS (
 SELECT `Spectral Class`, `Star category`, COUNT(*) AS cnt
 FROM cleaned
 GROUP BY `Spectral Class`, `Star category`
),
class_totals AS (
 SELECT `Spectral Class`, SUM(cnt) AS total
 FROM class_counts
 GROUP BY `Spectral Class`
),
class_majority AS (
 SELECT cc.`Spectral Class`, cc.`Star category` AS majority_category, cc.cnt AS majority_count,
        ct.total,
        cc.cnt / ct.total AS accuracy
 FROM class_counts cc
 JOIN class_totals ct ON cc.`Spectral Class` = ct.`Spectral Class`
 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.`Spectral Class` ORDER BY cc.cnt DESC) = 1
)
SELECT `Spectral Class`, majority_category, majority_count AS Count, accuracy AS Accuracy_Class
FROM class_majority
ORDER BY `Spectral Class`;

instruction:
Run a single SQL query on the `stars` table filtered to `Spectral Class = 'M'`. Group by `Star category`. For each group compute:
- `cnt` = COUNT(*)
- `temp_mean`, `temp_median`, `temp_std`, `temp_min`, `temp_max`
- `lum_mean`, `lum_median`, `lum_std`, `lum_min`, `lum_max`
- `rad_mean`, `rad_median`, `rad_std`, `rad_min`, `rad_max`
- `temp_lum_corr` = correlation coefficient between Temperature and Luminosity
- `temp_rad_corr` = correlation coefficient between Temperature and Radius
Use standard aggregates (AVG, COUNT, STDDEV_POP, MIN, MAX) and PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY `Star category`) for the median. For the correlations, compute covariance and divide by the product of the two stddevs using window functions. Return the results as a table with one row per `Star category`.

WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/total.total,1) AS pct_of_all,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars, total
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    "Spectral Class",
    sc_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT
    raw_color,
    string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT
  raw.raw_color,
  raw.n,
  raw.pct_of_all,
  raw.avg_temp,
  raw.avg_lum,
  raw.avg_rad,
  top2.top2
FROM raw
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw.n DESC;

Run a single SQL query that groups by `Spectral Class`. For each class return:
- `SpectralClass`
- `Count`
- `Proportion` (Count/240)
- `TempMean`, `TempMin`, `TempMax`, `TempStd`
- `LumMean`, `LumMin`, `LumMax`, `LumStd`
- `RadMean`, `RadMin`, `RadMax`, `RadStd`
- `ColorCounts` – a JSON object mapping each distinct `Star color` to its count within that spectral class.
Use AVG, MIN, MAX, STDDEV_POP, and a sub‑query or array aggregation for the color counts. Return the result as a JSON array of objects, one per spectral class.

message:
WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(lower("Star color")), '-', ' '), '\\s+', ' ') AS cleaned_color
  FROM stars
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class", cleaned_color AS star_color, "Star category", COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", cleaned_color, "Star category"
),
pair_totals AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class", star_color, SUM(cnt) AS total
  FROM pair_counts
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class", star_color
),
pair_majority AS (
  SELECT pc."Spectral Class", pc.star_color, pc."Star category" AS majority_category, pc.cnt AS majority_count,
         pt.total,
         pc.cnt / pt.total AS accuracy
  FROM pair_counts pc
  JOIN pair_totals pt ON pc."Spectral Class" = pt."Spectral Class" AND pc.star_color = pt.star_color
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc."Spectral Class", pc.star_color ORDER BY pc.cnt DESC) = 1
)
SELECT "Spectral Class", star_color, majority_category, majority_count AS Count, accuracy AS Accuracy_ClassColor
FROM pair_majority
ORDER BY "Spectral Class", star_color;

message:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
    COUNT(*) AS Count,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS TempMean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMean
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class"
),
 corr AS (
  SELECT
    CORR(Count, TempMean) AS Temp,
    CORR(Count, LumMean) AS Lum,
    CORR(Count, RadMean) AS Rad
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  json_arrayagg(json_object(
    'SpectralClass', SpectralClass,
    'Count', Count,
    'TempMean', TempMean,
    'LumMean', LumMean,
    'RadMean', RadMean
  )) AS class_stats,
  json_object(
    'Temp', (SELECT Temp FROM corr),
    'Lum', (SELECT Lum FROM corr),
    'Rad', (SELECT Rad FROM corr)
  ) AS correlations;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_10,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_90,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_10,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_90
  FROM stars
),
pop AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN "Luminosity (L/Lo)" <= p.lum_10 AND "Radius (R/Ro)" <= p.rad_10 THEN 'Very Small/Dim'
      WHEN "Luminosity (L/Lo)" >= p.lum_90 AND "Radius (R/Ro)" >= p.rad_90 THEN 'Very Large/Bright'
      ELSE 'Intermediate'
    END AS Population
  FROM stars, p
),
pc AS (
  SELECT Population, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pop GROUP BY Population
),
ps AS (
  SELECT Population, AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS mean_lum, AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS mean_rad FROM pop GROUP BY Population
),
bc AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Small/Dim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vsd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Large/Bright' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vlb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Intermediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inter
  FROM pop GROUP BY "Star category"
),
bt AS (
  SELECT "Star type" AS type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Small/Dim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vsd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Large/Bright' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vlb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Intermediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inter
  FROM pop GROUP BY "Star type"
)
SELECT json_object(
  'percentiles', json_object(
    'luminosity', json_object(
      '10th', p.lum_10,
      '25th', p.lum_25,
      '75th', p.lum_75,
      '90th', p.lum_90
    ),
    'radius', json_object(
      '10th', p.rad_10,
      '25th', p.rad_25,
      '75th', p.rad_75,
      '90th', p.rad_90
    )
  ),
  'population_counts', (SELECT json_arrayagg(json_object('Population', Population, 'count', cnt)) FROM pc),
  'population_stats', (SELECT json_arrayagg(json_object('Population', Population, 'mean_luminosity', mean_lum, 'mean_radius', mean_rad)) FROM ps),
  'by_category', (SELECT json_arrayagg(json_object('category', category, 'Very Small/Dim', vsd, 'Very Large/Bright', vlb, 'Intermediate', inter)) FROM bc),
  'by_type', (SELECT json_arrayagg(json_object('Star type', type, 'Very Small/Dim', vsd, 'Very Large/Bright', vlb, 'Intermediate', inter)) FROM bt)
) AS result FROM p;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT "Spectral Class" AS SpectralClass,
         COUNT(*) AS Count,
         AVG("Temperature (K)") AS TempMean,
         AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS LumMean,
         AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS RadMean
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Spectral Class"
),
 corr AS (
  SELECT CORR(Count, TempMean) AS Temp,
         CORR(Count, LumMean) AS Lum,
         CORR(Count, RadMean) AS Rad
  FROM agg
)
SELECT json_object(
  'class_stats', array_agg(json_object(
    'SpectralClass', SpectralClass,
    'Count', Count,
    'TempMean', TempMean,
    'LumMean', LumMean,
    'RadMean', RadMean
  )),
  'correlations', json_object(
    'Temp', corr.Temp,
    'Lum', corr.Lum,
    'Rad', corr.Rad
  )
) AS result
FROM agg
CROSS JOIN corr;

instruction:
Run a single SQL query on the `stars` table filtered to `Spectral Class = 'M'`. Group by `Star color`. For each color compute:
- `cnt` = COUNT(*)
- `temp_mean`, `temp_median`, `temp_std`, `temp_min`, `temp_max`
- `lum_mean`, `lum_median`, `lum_std`, `lum_min`, `lum_max`
- `rad_mean`, `rad_median`, `rad_std`, `rad_min`, `rad_max`
- `temp_lum_corr` = correlation coefficient between Temperature and Luminosity
- `temp_rad_corr` = correlation coefficient between Temperature and Radius
Use standard aggregates (AVG, COUNT, STDDEV_POP, MIN, MAX) and PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY `Star color`) for the median. For the correlations, compute covariance and divide by the product of the two stddevs using window functions. Return the results as a table with one row per `Star color`.

WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw_stats AS (
  SELECT "Star color" AS raw_color,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/total.total,1) AS pct_of_all,
         AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
         AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
         AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars, total
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral_counts AS (
  SELECT "Star color" AS raw_color, "Spectral Class", COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT raw_color, "Spectral Class", sc_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral_counts
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT raw_color, string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT raw_stats.raw_color, raw_stats.n, raw_stats.pct_of_all, raw_stats.avg_temp, raw_stats.avg_lum, raw_stats.avg_rad, top2.top2
FROM raw_stats
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw_stats.n DESC;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_10,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_90,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_10,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_90
  FROM stars
),
pop AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN "Luminosity (L/Lo)" <= p.lum_10 AND "Radius (R/Ro)" <= p.rad_10 THEN 'Very Small/Dim'
      WHEN "Luminosity (L/Lo)" >= p.lum_90 AND "Radius (R/Ro)" >= p.rad_90 THEN 'Very Large/Bright'
      ELSE 'Intermediate'
    END AS Population
  FROM stars, p
),
pc AS (
  SELECT Population, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pop GROUP BY Population
),
ps AS (
  SELECT Population, AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS mean_lum, AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS mean_rad FROM pop GROUP BY Population
),
bc AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Small/Dim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vsd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Large/Bright' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vlb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Intermediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inter
  FROM pop GROUP BY "Star category"
),
bt AS (
  SELECT "Star type" AS type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Small/Dim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vsd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Large/Bright' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vlb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Intermediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inter
  FROM pop GROUP BY "Star type"
)
SELECT json_object(
  'percentiles', json_object(
    'luminosity', json_object(
      '10th', p.lum_10,
      '25th', p.lum_25,
      '75th', p.lum_75,
      '90th', p.lum_90
    ),
    'radius', json_object(
      '10th', p.rad_10,
      '25th', p.rad_25,
      '75th', p.rad_75,
      '90th', p.rad_90
    )
  ),
  'population_counts', json_array(array_agg(json_object('Population', Population, 'count', cnt))) FROM pc,
  'population_stats', json_array(array_agg(json_object('Population', Population, 'mean_luminosity', mean_lum, 'mean_radius', mean_rad))) FROM ps,
  'by_category', json_array(array_agg(json_object('category', category, 'Very Small/Dim', vsd, 'Very Large/Bright', vlb, 'Intermediate', inter))) FROM bc,
  'by_type', json_array(array_agg(json_object('Star type', type, 'Very Small/Dim', vsd, 'Very Large/Bright', vlb, 'Intermediate', inter))) FROM bt
) AS result;

WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stars),
raw_stats AS (
  SELECT "Star color" AS raw_color,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT total FROM total),1) AS pct_of_all,
         AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp,
         AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum,
         AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color"
),
spectral_counts AS (
  SELECT "Star color" AS raw_color, "Spectral Class", COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT raw_color, "Spectral Class", sc_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY raw_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral_counts
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT raw_color, string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY raw_color
)
SELECT raw_stats.raw_color, raw_stats.n, raw_stats.pct_of_all, raw_stats.avg_temp, raw_stats.avg_lum, raw_stats.avg_rad, top2.top2
FROM raw_stats
JOIN top2 USING (raw_color)
ORDER BY raw_stats.n DESC;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_10,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_90,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_10,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_90
  FROM stars
),
pop AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN "Luminosity (L/Lo)" <= p.lum_10 AND "Radius (R/Ro)" <= p.rad_10 THEN 'Very Small/Dim'
      WHEN "Luminosity (L/Lo)" >= p.lum_90 AND "Radius (R/Ro)" >= p.rad_90 THEN 'Very Large/Bright'
      ELSE 'Intermediate'
    END AS Population
  FROM stars, p
),
pc AS (
  SELECT Population, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pop GROUP BY Population
),
ps AS (
  SELECT Population, AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS mean_lum, AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS mean_rad FROM pop GROUP BY Population
),
bc AS (
  SELECT "Star category" AS category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Small/Dim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vsd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Large/Bright' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vlb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Intermediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inter
  FROM pop GROUP BY "Star category"
),
bt AS (
  SELECT "Star type" AS type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Small/Dim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vsd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Very Large/Bright' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vlb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Population='Intermediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inter
  FROM pop GROUP BY "Star type"
)
SELECT json_object(
  'percentiles', json_object(
    'luminosity', json_object(
      '10th', p.lum_10,
      '25th', p.lum_25,
      '75th', p.lum_75,
      '90th', p.lum_90
    ),
    'radius', json_object(
      '10th', p.rad_10,
      '25th', p.rad_25,
      '75th', p.rad_75,
      '90th', p.rad_90
    )
  ),
  'population_counts', (SELECT json_array(array_agg(json_object('Population', Population, 'count', cnt))) FROM pc),
  'population_stats', (SELECT json_array(array_agg(json_object('Population', Population, 'mean_luminosity', mean_lum, 'mean_radius', mean_rad))) FROM ps),
  'by_category', (SELECT json_array(array_agg(json_object('category', category, 'Very Small/Dim', vsd, 'Very Large/Bright', vlb, 'Intermediate', inter))) FROM bc),
  'by_type', (SELECT json_array(array_agg(json_object('Star type', type, 'Very Small/Dim', vsd, 'Very Large/Bright', vlb, 'Intermediate', inter))) FROM bt)
) AS result FROM p;

WITH stars_with_id AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS star_id FROM stars
),
cat_means AS (
  SELECT
    "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
color_cat_means AS (
  SELECT
    "Star color" AS color,
    "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean
  FROM stars
  GROUP BY "Star color", "Star category"
),
pred_physical AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s."Star color" AS color,
    c.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - c.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - c.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - c.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM stars_with_id s
  CROSS JOIN cat_means c
),
pred_physical_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical
),
pred_physical_color AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s."Star color" AS color,
    cc.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - cc.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - cc.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - cc.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM stars_with_id s
  LEFT JOIN color_cat_means cc
    ON s."Star color" = cc.color
),
pred_physical_color_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical_color
),
final_preds AS (
  SELECT
    p.star_id,
    p.actual_cat,
    p.color,
    p.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physical,
    pc.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physicalcolor
  FROM pred_physical_min p
  LEFT JOIN pred_physical_color_min pc
    ON p.star_id = pc.star_id AND pc.rn = 1
),
per_category AS (
  SELECT
    actual_cat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physicalcolor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physicalcolor
  FROM final_preds
  GROUP BY actual_cat
),
accuracy AS (
  SELECT
    actual_cat,
    correct_physical,
    misclass_physical,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS accuracy_physical,
    correct_physicalcolor,
    misclass_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor), 2) AS accuracy_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor) -
          100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS improvement
  FROM per_category
),
global_diff AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stars), 2) AS diff_percent
  FROM final_preds
  WHERE pred_cat_physical <> pred_cat_physicalcolor
)
SELECT * FROM accuracy, global_diff;

pred_physical_color AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s."Star color" AS color,
    cc.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - cc.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - cc.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - cc.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM stars_with_id s
  LEFT JOIN color_cat_means cc
    ON s."Star color" = cc.color
),
pred_physical_color_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical_color
),
final_preds AS (
  SELECT
    p.star_id,
    p.actual_cat,
    p.color,
    p.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physical,
    pc.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physicalcolor
  FROM pred_physical_min p
  LEFT JOIN pred_physical_color_min pc
    ON p.star_id = pc.star_id AND pc.rn = 1
),
per_category AS (
  SELECT
    actual_cat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physicalcolor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physicalcolor
  FROM final_preds
  GROUP BY actual_cat
),
accuracy AS (
  SELECT
    actual_cat,
    correct_physical,
    misclass_physical,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS accuracy_physical,
    correct_physicalcolor,
    misclass_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor), 2) AS accuracy_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor) -
          100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS improvement
  FROM per_category
),
global_diff AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stars), 2) AS diff_percent
  FROM final_preds
  WHERE pred_cat_physical <> pred_cat_physicalcolor
)
SELECT * FROM accuracy, global_diff;

message:
WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *,
    lower(replace(replace(trim("Star color"), ' ', ''), '-', '')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
cat_means AS (
  SELECT
    "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
color_cat_means AS (
  SELECT
    clean_color AS color,
    "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY clean_color, "Star category"
),
star_ids AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS star_id FROM cleaned
),
pred_physical AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s.clean_color AS color,
    c.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - c.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - c.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - c.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM star_ids s
  CROSS JOIN cat_means c
),
pred_physical_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical
),
pred_physical_color AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s.clean_color AS color,
    cc.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - cc.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - cc.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - cc.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM star_ids s
  LEFT JOIN color_cat_means cc
    ON s.clean_color = cc.color
),
pred_physical_color_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical_color
),
final_preds AS (
  SELECT
    p.star_id,
    p.actual_cat,
    p.color,
    p.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physical,
    pc.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physicalcolor
  FROM pred_physical_min p
  LEFT JOIN pred_physical_color_min pc
    ON p.star_id = pc.star_id AND pc.rn = 1
),
per_category AS (
  SELECT
    actual_cat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physicalcolor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physicalcolor
  FROM final_preds
  GROUP BY actual_cat
),
accuracy AS (
  SELECT
    actual_cat,
    correct_physical,
    misclass_physical,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS accuracy_physical,
    correct_physicalcolor,
    misclass_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor), 2) AS accuracy_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor) -
          100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS improvement
  FROM per_category
),
global_diff AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM star_ids), 2) AS diff_percent
  FROM final_preds
  WHERE pred_cat_physical <> pred_cat_physicalcolor
)
SELECT a.actual_cat, a.correct_physical, a.misclass_physical, a.accuracy_physical,
       a.correct_physicalcolor, a.misclass_physicalcolor, a.accuracy_physicalcolor,
       a.improvement,
       g.diff_count, g.diff_percent
FROM accuracy a CROSS JOIN global_diff g
ORDER BY a.actual_cat;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *,
    lower(replace(replace(trim("Star color"), ' ', ''), '-', '')) AS clean_color
  FROM stars
),
cat_means AS (
  SELECT
    "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY "Star category"
),
color_cat_means AS (
  SELECT
    clean_color AS color,
    "Star category" AS cat,
    AVG("Temperature (K)") AS temp_mean,
    AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS lum_mean,
    AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS rad_mean
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY clean_color, "Star category"
),
star_ids AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS star_id FROM cleaned
),
pred_physical AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s.clean_color AS color,
    c.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - c.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - c.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - c.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM star_ids s
  CROSS JOIN cat_means c
),
pred_physical_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical
),
pred_physical_color AS (
  SELECT
    s.star_id,
    s."Star category" AS actual_cat,
    s.clean_color AS color,
    cc.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)" - cc.temp_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)" - cc.lum_mean, 2) +
         POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)" - cc.rad_mean, 2)) AS dist
  FROM star_ids s
  LEFT JOIN color_cat_means cc
    ON s.clean_color = cc.color
),
pred_physical_color_min AS (
  SELECT
    star_id,
    actual_cat,
    color,
    pred_cat,
    dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical_color
),
final_preds AS (
  SELECT
    p.star_id,
    p.actual_cat,
    p.color,
    p.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physical,
    pc.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physicalcolor
  FROM pred_physical_min p
  LEFT JOIN pred_physical_color_min pc
    ON p.star_id = pc.star_id AND pc.rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_preds;

WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT *, lower(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim("Star color"), '\\s+', ' '), '-', ' ')) AS cleaned_color
  FROM stars
),
raw_stats AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stars),1) AS pct_of_all,
         AVG("Temperature (K)") AS avg_temp, AVG("Luminosity (L/Lo)") AS avg_lum, AVG("Radius (R/Ro)") AS avg_rad
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY cleaned_color
),
spectral_counts AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, "Spectral Class", COUNT(*) AS sc_count
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY cleaned_color, "Spectral Class"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, "Spectral Class", sc_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cleaned_color ORDER BY sc_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM spectral_counts
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT cleaned_color, string_agg(concat("Spectral Class", ':', sc_count), ', ') AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY cleaned_color
)
SELECT raw_stats.cleaned_color, raw_stats.n, raw_stats.pct_of_all, raw_stats.avg_temp, raw_stats.avg_lum, raw_stats.avg_rad, top2.top2
FROM raw_stats
JOIN top2 USING (cleaned_color)
ORDER BY raw_stats.n DESC;

  GROUP BY "Star category"

color_cat_means AS (

  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY clean_color, "Star category"
),
star_ids AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS star_id FROM cleaned),
pred_physical AS (
  SELECT s.star_id, s."Star category" AS actual_cat, s.clean_color AS color, c.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)"-c.temp_mean,2)+POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-c.lum_mean,2)+POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)"-c.rad_mean,2)) AS dist
  FROM star_ids s CROSS JOIN cat_means c
),
pred_physical_min AS (
  SELECT star_id, actual_cat, color, pred_cat, dist, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical
),
pred_physical_color AS (
  SELECT s.star_id, s."Star category" AS actual_cat, s.clean_color AS color, cc.cat AS pred_cat,
    SQRT(POWER(s."Temperature (K)"-cc.temp_mean,2)+POWER(s."Luminosity (L/Lo)"-cc.lum_mean,2)+POWER(s."Radius (R/Ro)"-cc.rad_mean,2)) AS dist
  FROM star_ids s LEFT JOIN color_cat_means cc ON s.clean_color = cc.color
),
pred_physical_color_min AS (
  SELECT star_id, actual_cat, color, pred_cat, dist, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY star_id ORDER BY dist) AS rn
  FROM pred_physical_color
),
final_preds AS (
  SELECT p.star_id, p.actual_cat, p.color, p.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physical, pc.pred_cat AS pred_cat_physicalcolor
  FROM pred_physical_min p
  JOIN pred_physical_color_min pc ON p.star_id = pc.star_id AND pc.rn = 1
  WHERE p.rn = 1
),
per_category AS (
  SELECT actual_cat,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physical <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physical,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor = actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_physicalcolor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pred_cat_physicalcolor <> actual_cat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS misclass_physicalcolor
  FROM final_preds
  GROUP BY actual_cat
),
accuracy AS (
  SELECT actual_cat,
    correct_physical, misclass_physical,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physical / (correct_physical + misclass_physical), 2) AS accuracy_physical,

    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor), 2) AS accuracy_physicalcolor,
    ROUND(100.0 * correct_physicalcolor / (correct_physicalcolor + misclass_physicalcolor) -

  FROM per_category
),

  SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM star_ids), 2) AS diff_percent
  FROM final_preds
  WHERE pred_cat_physical <> pred_cat_physicalcolor
)

       a.correct_physicalcolor, a.misclass_physicalcolor, a.accuracy_physicalcolor,
       a.improvement,
       g.diff_count, g.diff_percent
FROM accuracy a CROSS JOIN global_diff g
ORDER BY a.actual_cat;

message: The most striking observation is that the underrepresented spectral classes K and G, each with only six and one stars respectively, exhibit markedly lower temperatures and luminosities compared to the dominant M class, yet their radii are comparable to the hotter O and B stars.  Across all categories, the M class dominates the dataset (46% of stars) and shows the lowest mean temperature (~3,257 K) but the highest mean radius (~1,673 R☉) and luminosity (~550,000 L☉).  The analysis used standard aggregates (AVG, MIN, MAX, STDDEV_POP) and computed proportions relative to total counts per spectral class and per star category, ensuring no NULLs influenced the calculations.  The summary rows per spectral class provide a baseline for comparison with individual category statistics.
